content: Rumai to Babel to daba mala
Muuŋ, tamtoghon to tineep izi taan, tisob tisavia aliŋadi ee moghon, ve saveeŋ todi raraate.
Yes tineep izi ndug ee moghon maau. Tindurnduur tilala pa ndag iza, le tivot izi taan raapa eez to ineep ila taan suruvu to Sinar, ve tighur inadi to nepooŋ tonowe.

Ghoro tiwasavon di tighaze: “Laak! Iit irau tapol taan ve tamozi ila yab. Leso iyaryaaŋ kat inimale yaam ve tagharaat ruum pani.” Tigham tovene, ve ledi mbeb ivot pa reiŋ ruum. Ve tigham mbeb ite inimale ndimir pa ikor yaam tonowen le tuŋia.

Ghoro tisaav tighaze: “Laak! Iit irau tagharaat leed ndug tiina eta, ve tarei rumai tiina eta to daba izala le ikis tata. Leso izaad ivot inim tiina. Ve mbeb ite. Uraat tiina tonene pale ilup ghiit tanim ee moghon. Pa vene, tambiriis ve taneep leed leed irau taan to naol ne.”
Yes tigham mbeb tonene le isob, ghoro Yoova izi inim ighaze ighita ndug todi tiina tonowen ve rumai to tireii izala le izala kat.

Ye ighita di, ve isaav ighaze: “Wai, tamtoghon tilup di tinim ee moghon wa! Ve tisavia aliŋadi ee moghon, ve aazne tipamundigin uraat tiina tonene paam. Muri, ighaze tigham ŋgar pa uraat tintina pida, pale matadi sorok ve tighami moghon. Pasa, mbeb eta irau ila muridi maau.
Tovenen iit tazila ve tatoor aliŋadi inim naol. Leso tiwaloŋan aliŋadi muul sob.”
Ataam tonene to Yoova igham di tipul uraat ineep, ve ireu di tila tineep irau taan isob.
Ndug tiina tonowen, tiwaat iza tighaze ‘Babel.’
Pasa, indeeŋ sawa to tamtoghon tisob to taan tilup di izi ndug tonowen, Yoova itoor aliŋadi, ve ireu di tighau tila tineep ledi ledi irau taan isob. Mbaŋ 2:4+
Sem papaghu toni

Nene pitiiŋ to Sem toman papaghu toni. Yawaaŋa tiina ivot le isob, ve ndaman ru inim ila, ghoro Sem yesuru azuwa tipoop natudi aidaba, iza Apaksad. Sawa tonenen, Sem ndaman toni irau tamoot liim (100).
Apaksad izi, ve Sem ineep muul irau ndaman 500, ve tipoop ndinatudi nditamoot ve ndiliva pida, ghoro imaat.
Apaksad ndaman toni irau 35, ve yesuru azuwa tipoop natudi aidaba, iza Sela.
Sela izi, ve Apaksad ineep muul irau ndaman 403, ve tipoop ndinatudi nditamoot ve ndiliva pida, ghoro imaat.
Sela ndaman toni irau 30, ve yesuru azuwa tipoop natudi aidaba, iza Eber.
Eber izi, ve Sela ineep muul irau ndaman 403, ve tipoop ndinatudi nditamoot ve ndiliva pida, ghoro imaat.
Eber ndaman toni irau 34, ve yesuru azuwa tipoop natudi aidaba, iza Peleg.
Peleg izi, ve Eber ineep muul irau ndaman 430, ve tipoop ndinatudi nditamoot ve ndiliva pida, ghoro imaat.
Peleg ndaman toni irau 30, ve yesuru azuwa tipoop natudi aidaba, iza Reu.
Reu izi ve Peleg ineep muul irau ndaman 209, ve tipoop ndinatudi nditamoot ve ndiliva pida, ghoro imaat.
Reu ndaman toni irau 32, ve yesuru azuwa tipoop natudi aidaba, iza Seruk.
Seruk izi, ve Reu ineep muul irau ndaman 207, ve tipoop ndinatudi nditamoot ve ndiliva pida, ghoro imaat.
Seruk ndaman toni irau 30, ve yesuru azuwa tipoop natudi aidaba, iza Naor.
Naor izi, ve Seruk ineep muul irau ndaman 200, ve tipoop ndinatudi nditamoot ve ndiliva pida, ghoro imaat.
Naor ndaman toni irau 29, ve yesuru azuwa tipoop natudi aidaba, iza Tera.
Tera izi, ve Naor ineep muul irau ndaman 119, ve tipoop ndinatudi nditamoot ve ndiliva pida, ghoro imaat.
Tera ndaman toni irau 70, ghoro yesuru azuwa tipoop ndinatudi tol, izadi Abram, Naor, ve Aran.
Kamos to Tera toman papaghu toni
Nene kamos to Tera toman papaghu toni. Tera ndinatu, Abram, Naor, ve Aran. Aran natu Lot.
Tera inepneep sone, ve natu Aran imaat izi tau ndug toni Ur to ineep izi taan suruvu to Kaldia.
Abram ivai Sarai, ve Naor ivai Milka. Milka yesuru Yiska tamandi Aran.
Sarai, ipoop maau. Pasa, ye uupa. Mbnp 25:21

Muri ghoro, Tera igham natu Abram, timbu Lot to Aran natu, ve rawa liva Sarai to Abram azuwa, ve tipul ndug Ur to ineep ila taan suruvu to Kaldia, ve tighaze tila pa taan Kanaan. Eemoghon tila tivot ndug Aran, ve tizi tineep tonowe.
Tera ndaman toni irau 205, ghoro imaat tonowe.
